uncited: **Inputs:** Sparse source views (images) and their corresponding camera parameters (intrinsics $K$, extrinsics).
**Outputs:** A set of 3D Gaussians defined by position $\mu$, color $c$, opacity $\alpha$, and covariance $\Sigma$, which can be rendered to novel views.
The method operates on 2D Gaussian parameter maps defined on the sparse source view image plane.
**Correlation Volume Generation:** For a target view $I_{tar}$, select two neighboring source views $I_r$ and $I_l$.
**Gaussian Feature Generation:** Generate depth features using a depth encoder.
**Rendering:** Render the scene using the standard 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterization pipeline.
The 3D covariance $\Sigma$ is decomposed into a rotation matrix $R$ and a scaling matrix $S$.
